question: After exact-head live proof is supplied, should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106961?
rationale: Both branches implement the same core behavior, while the sibling also changes model-facing schema guidance; choosing one landing branch and consolidating any useful tests or wording requires owner judgment.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Keep this branch's broader focused regression matrix, require live proof, and port the sibling's schema wording only if maintainers consider it necessary.

options.title: Use the sibling PR
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 if the model-facing omission guidance should ship atomically, after matching this branch's test coverage and adding live proof.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Keep the issue open and replace both branches with an owner-authored fix if neither candidate proves continuation and exactly-once recovery satisfactorily.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
